headline: Brazilian Bond Yields Surge as Post-Runoff Selloff Erases Rally
summary: Brazilian Treasury bonds lost up to 17% in the week following the runoff election, with pre-fixed rates reaching 15.36% and IPCA+ rising to 7.89%.
why: Brazilian sovereign yields dictate borrowing costs across Latin America's largest economy and reflect institutional expectations regarding domestic fiscal policy and inflation.

impacts.name: Brazil sovereign bond yields
impacts.why: Treasury bond yields jumped sharply with pre-fixed rates reaching 15.36% after heavy bond price drops.
